type dir = North | East | South | West
type robot = { pos : int * int; dir : dir }

let move r cmds =
  String.fold_left
    (fun r c ->
      match c with
      | 'A' -> let x, y = r.pos in { r with pos = (x, y + 1) }
      | 'L' | 'R' -> r
      | c -> failwith (Printf.sprintf "bad %c" c))
    r cmds

module type S = sig val x : int end
module M : S = struct let x = 1 end
let () = let r = move { pos = (0, 0); dir = North } "AA" in Printf.printf "%d\n" (snd r.pos + M.x)
